众所周知，fooocus 对 SD1.5 使用了一种非常特殊的精炼方法。从最近版本开始，可以在高级设置中设置 "切换时间"。

尝试这个非常有趣。我们仍在实验中，准备好后会以更正式的方式记录它。

我认为我应该放一个早期示例

以下是 "女人，街道"，种子 1234，run.bat 默认参数（默认 sdxl + 精炼）

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789200-66a083c0-a3f6-4ffc-9d32-fdf8cd502de4.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..IG4X-u-W3WOyte1cKmqqNr412I66MTMgGc_p5UK5T78)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789200-66a083c0-a3f6-4ffc-9d32-fdf8cd502de4.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..IG4X-u-W3WOyte1cKmqqNr412I66MTMgGc_p5UK5T78)

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789292-200ea056-195d-4b85-aaae-bdf27695dfc1.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..2nHnTbiuQ9fjGd74gv6M5zSPHiXdilUchWUglAzKPp4)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789292-200ea056-195d-4b85-aaae-bdf27695dfc1.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..2nHnTbiuQ9fjGd74gv6M5zSPHiXdilUchWUglAzKPp4)

然后你下载 Realistic Vision V5.1（它是 SD1.5）[https://civitai.com/models/4201/realistic-vision-v51](https://civitai.com/models/4201/realistic-vision-v51)

然后将其设置为精炼器

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789273-d2bef946-4a64-4118-a4f5-1424af02f0db.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Co3dFzeJusJhw3m21aZqGuiUAAOkgvdV2W2XkR5oCT4)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789273-d2bef946-4a64-4118-a4f5-1424af02f0db.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Co3dFzeJusJhw3m21aZqGuiUAAOkgvdV2W2XkR5oCT4)

然后将精炼器开关设置为0.4

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789288-097df587-66a1-4e9e-a871-cfa4e126617e.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..FFI8KG0uTY55fJN91d_8R0r05sqyARICq8XGgHewtBg)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789288-097df587-66a1-4e9e-a871-cfa4e126617e.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..FFI8KG0uTY55fJN91d_8R0r05sqyARICq8XGgHewtBg)

然后你就得到这个

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789352-014d166a-478b-4f0c-a8eb-c59015b58915.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.._jLqf4xK3mgp9wJhi3-Tf3yvTo4Bzg_CLW_1GQRvLts)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789352-014d166a-478b-4f0c-a8eb-c59015b58915.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.._jLqf4xK3mgp9wJhi3-Tf3yvTo4Bzg_CLW_1GQRvLts)

简直太惊了 - 这到底是怎么回事

[![image](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789362-e6130bac-fefa-470c-9306-017121565035.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..XkigHZnSOo5Xh4h2R3QacIXO_qISlK6bVVKDfLNz7EM)](https://private-user-images.githubusercontent.com/19834515/278789362-e6130bac-fefa-470c-9306-017121565035.png?jwt=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..XkigHZnSOo5Xh4h2R3QacIXO_qISlK6bVVKDfLNz7EM)

我也试过 dreamsharperv8，但对于真实图像来说，Realistic Vision 看起来更好

请注意我们仍在进行实验，交换算法在未来可能会有所改变。（也许潜在图像的饱和度会再次被审查，可能）

此交换算法仅在 Fooocus 中可用。
